notifications.title: Set one end screen on each long video
notifications.detail: Guides rate a single, specific next video as the best ending for session watch time. End screens can only be set in YouTube Studio, at upload.
notifications.fix: 1. When uploading a long video, open Editor → End screen. 2. Add one 'Video' element pointing to our closest long video in subject (e.g. 'The 6 levels of money in India' for any rich-vs-poor or which-one-are-you video). 3. Add the Subscribe element. Nothing else.

notifications.title: Scout didn't run on Oct 24, 25 and 26
notifications.detail: There's no scout activity file or agent/scout branch for 2026-10-24 to 26, and the last one before today is 2026-10-23. The other agents ran on the 24th and 26th, so the Scout routine itself didn't fire or stopped early. The feed was down to 2 usable topics by this morning (now 5). Monday's weekly thumbnail examples were missed too.
notifications.fix: 1. Open claude.ai/code → Routines and check the Scout routine (daily 09:37 IST): enabled, and on a daily schedule. 2. Open its runs for Oct 24–26 and check whether they failed or hit the usage limit. 3. If it hit the limit, nothing to change: today's run worked. If it's disabled or failing, re-enable it or fix the error shown.
